spells.notes: 전두환-era minister still in office on 1988-02-25 (caretaker holdover). Named in the 7·13 reshuffle on the afternoon of 1987-07-13 and given his 임명장 on the morning of 1987-07-14, the date the MOE list prints. With the rest of the 김정렬 cabinet he handed in his resignation when the 5th Republic ended at midnight of 1988-02-24, and 노태우 accepted the resignations on the morning of 1988-02-25 before giving the new cabinet its 임명장 (same-day handover). The MOE list prints 1988-02-24 as his last day, following its day-before-the-successor convention. He attended the joint 이·취임식 on the morning of 1988-02-26 as former minister. spells.notes: Kim Young-sam-era holdover in office on 1998-02-25. Appointed in the 1997-08-05 reshuffle (문화일보 1997-08-06: '김영삼 대통령은 5일 오후 개각을 단행, ... 교육부장관에 이명현 서울대교수, ... 각각 임명했다'). The MOE page and ko.wikipedia give 1997-08-06, probably the 임명장/취임 date, which cannot be checked in the 관보 because there are no digital files before 2001. End set to the 1998-03-03 appointment of the Kim Dae-jung cabinet (same-day handover); the MOE page lists 1998-03-02. Birth date from ko.wikipedia '이명현 (1942년)' revid 41473420 https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=41473420 [snapshot roster/sources/education/wiki/kowiki_bio_이명현_(1942년).json; accessed 2026-09-25T13:33:17-0400] (secondary). issues.desc: Start convention. Before 2001 there is no digital 관보, so the start is the 임명장 day, which is also the MOE 취임일자. In six transitions the appointment was announced the day before (1987-07-13, 1992-01-22, 1993-12-21, 1995-05-15, 1995-12-20, 1997-08-05). For the same reshuffles the official lists of 내무부 (mois), 총무처, 보건사회부/보건복지부, 과학기술처/체신부 (msit), 환경처/환경부 (mcee), 통일원 (unikorea) and 농림수산부 (mafra) also print the 임명장 day. In ext88/other_ministry_pages.json the reshuffle announced 1987-07-13 is printed as 1987-07-14 by mois_govadmin, mois_home, msit, the reshuffle announced 1993-12-21 is printed as 1993-12-22 by mafra, mcee, mohw, mois_govadmin, mois_home, unikorea, the reshuffle announced 1995-05-15 is printed as 1995-05-16 by mohw, the reshuffle announced 1995-12-20 is printed as 1995-12-21 by mcee, mohw, mois_home, msit, unikorea, the reshuffle announced 1997-08-05 is printed as 1997-08-06 by mcee, mohw, mois_govadmin, mois_home and as 1997-08-05 by moj. The 법무부 list prints 1997-08-05 for 김종구 in the 8·5 reshuffle, and the main justice file uses that date, while the main education file uses 1997-08-06 for 이명현. The two main files follow different conventions for the same reshuffle. This file follows the education one. The announcement dates are in the notes and in nominations[].nomination_date.

End convention and differences from the MOE list. The MOE 퇴임일자 is the day before the successor's 취임일자. This file uses the day the minister was relieved, so it differs from the MOE list for 서명원 (MOE 1988-02-24, file 1988-02-25, the 5th Republic cabinet's 일괄사표 were accepted on the morning of 1988-02-25 per 조선일보 1988-02-26, 매일경제 1988-02-25 and 중앙일보 1988-02-25), 김영식 (MOE 1988-12-04, file 1988-12-05, same-day reshuffle and 임명장) and 김숙희 (current MOE list and ko.wikipedia 1995-05-11, the 2000 edition of the MOE list and the news 1995-05-12, the day of the 해임).
